## Run A - `112 101` (set path)

**Narration**

1. **Route to the set path.** There are two PR tokens and no `--rebase` flag, so the set-routing row in `reference/batch.md` takes over before steps 1-7.
2. **Read the origin remote.** `git remote get-url origin` returns `git@github.com:acme/widgets.git`. With `.git` stripped and the name lowercased, origin is `acme/widgets`.
3. **Admit the set before any effects.** All admission checks pass:
   - There is no positional issue reference.
   - There are no duplicate identities: `acme/widgets#112` and `acme/widgets#101` are distinct.
   - Both tokens are bare numbers, so both resolve to origin.
   - The set size of 2 is within `parallel.maxTasks` of 4.
   - The harness is pi.
   
   This is a typed set, so no `discovered, smallest first:` line is printed.
4. **Mint the parent run folder.** I mint one parent `RUN_DIR` from the session checkout using `post-selection-loop.md` `### Continuation record`. It succeeds.
5. **Gather each PR.** I run the batch `gh pr view` once per token, in typed order, passing each token unchanged as `pr_token`. Each call uses the `--json number,author,headRefOid,headRefName,baseRefName,isCrossRepository,headRepository,state,files,url,title,body,additions,deletions,closingIssuesReferences,reviewRequests` projection with the `linearRefs` jq filter.
   - `gh pr view "112" ...` returns the #112 row.
   - `gh pr view "101" ...` returns the #101 row.
6. **Read viewer identity once each.**
   - `gh api user --jq .login` returns `alex`.
   - `gh api user/teams --paginate --jq '.[] | .organization.login + "/" + .slug'` returns `acme/reviewers`.
7. **Read the ticket-display configuration.** `git symbolic-ref --short refs/remotes/origin/HEAD` resolves the default branch. I then run `git show <ref>:<path>` over the overrides search order. There is no tracker override, so Linear IDs stay allowed, but no Linear lookup is needed.
8. **Work out each list entry.**
   - **#112:** The author is pat and there are no pending requests, so the label is `by pat`. Its first closing reference is #22 in `acme/widgets`, which matches origin.
   - **#101:** The author matches the viewer, so the label is `yours`. It has no closing references. The branch `gh-45-retry` starts with `gh-45`, which gives issue #45 on origin.
9. **Print the typed-set list.** It goes out as its own message with no marker, and I continue without waiting.

---
PRs to gate:
- [#112](https://github.com/acme/widgets/pull/112) +300 -80, by pat, [#22](https://github.com/acme/widgets/issues/22) - centralize settings reads behind one resolver
- [#101](https://github.com/acme/widgets/pull/101) +3 -1, yours, [#45](https://github.com/acme/widgets/issues/45) - raise the default retry timeout for slow requests
---

**Next step:** serial provisioning under `reference/batch.md` `## Provision serially`.
- It starts with a single `git fetch origin`.
- Worktree configuration is resolved from the base merge-base.
- Then #112 and #101 are provisioned one at a time, in roster order.
- No rebase confirmation is needed, because `--rebase` was not passed.

## Run B - `97` (single-PR path)

**Narration**

1. **Route to the single-PR path.** There is one PR token and no `--rebase` flag.
2. **Set up the run.**
   - I mint the run folder and initialize its continuation record (`reference/post-selection-loop.md` `### Continuation record`).
   - Then I initialize the tracker with `plan_tracker` `init` and three stages: `gather`, `provision`, `verify`. There is no `sync` stage because `--rebase` was not passed.
3. **Step 1, gather.** I follow `verification-brief.md` Section A's fixed reads:
   - `gh pr view "97" --json number,title,body,author,state,isDraft,headRefName,baseRefName,isCrossRepository,mergeable,headRefOid,statusCheckRollup,files,additions,deletions,commits,reviews,closingIssuesReferences,reviewDecision,headRepository,maintainerCanModify,mergeStateStatus,url,mergeCommit,reviewRequests`
   - `gh run list -R acme/widgets -c <headRefOid> --json databaseId,status,conclusion,workflowName,url`
   - `gh api user --jq .login` returns `alex`.
   - `gh api user/teams --paginate --jq ...` returns `acme/reviewers`.
   - The fixed GraphQL query for `viewerPermission`, `viewerCanUpdateBranch`, `viewerCanMergeAsAdmin` and `viewerCanClose`.
   - `gh repo view acme/widgets --json nameWithOwner`
   - `gh pr diff "97"`
   - `gh api repos/acme/widgets/pulls/97/reviews --paginate`
   - `gh api repos/acme/widgets/pulls/97/comments --paginate`
   - `gh api repos/acme/widgets/issues/97/comments --paginate`
   - `git worktree list --porcelain` shows no worktree for #97.
4. **What the gather resolved.**
   - **Issue reference:** none was found, so `issue_ref` is null.
   - **Viewer role:** a pending User request for `alex` gives `requested reviewer`.
5. **Ticket display.**
   - `git symbolic-ref --short refs/remotes/origin/HEAD`, then `git show <ref>:<path>` over the overrides search order, finds no tracker override.
   - There are no closing references.
   - The branch `csv-export` gives no `gh-<N>` and no Linear ID, because `csv-` is followed by letters, not digits.
   - The title has no token and there are no `linearRefs`, so the entry shows `no ticket`.
6. **Print the single-PR list.** It goes out as its own message with no marker, and I proceed straight to step 2.

---
PR to gate:
- [#97](https://github.com/acme/widgets/pull/97) +40 -12, by robin, requested from you, no ticket - add a CSV export button for the widget list
---
Paired call: `plan_tracker({ action: "update", index: 0, status: "complete" })`

That call closes `gather` in the same reply as the list.

**Next step:** step 2, provision and configure (`reference/assessment.md`).
- Provision the #97 worktree.
- Resolve configuration from the merge-base.
- Select the scope contract. With no ticket, that means the spec at the head, else the PR's stated intent.
